source: Hospitals' own CMS price transparency machine-readable files (45 CFR Part 180), located through each hospital's cms-hpt.txt
method: cms-hpt.txt location-name strictly matched to the hospital's CCN; streamed MRF parse; shared contract in etl/price_contract.py
referenceDateRule: latest retrieval date among the extracts read (not the build date)
staleRule: stale = priceVintage more than 18 months before referenceDate

contract.hospitalMatching: a cms-hpt.txt entry is used only when its location-name resolves to this CCN through price_contract.StrictHospitalMatcher (identical distinctive name tokens + same city/ZIP, or a strict token subset with >= 2 shared tokens in the same city); re-checked at every rebuild
contract.codeMatching: explicit MS-DRG:/CPT:/HCPCS: code types only; codes with suffixes/modifiers rejected
contract.scope: one canonical scope per procedure; CPT/HCPCS lines must be billing_class facility and setting outpatient or both; MS-DRG lines inpatient/both/unspecified and not professional
contract.cash: discounted_cash only; gross charge never used as cash
contract.negotiated: standard_charge_dollar per payer+plan, then median/min/max across plans; per diem and percent-of-charges excluded; percentages/algorithms never converted
contract.bounds: values <= 0, >= 500000, sentinels and values under the procedure floor dropped
contract.vintage: the MRF's last_updated_on; missing, unparseable or after the retrieval date -> quarantined
contract.mrfUrl: the https mrf-url listed in the hospital's cms-hpt.txt; sourceDataset = that cms-hpt.txt URL
contract.dedupe: one row per CMS hospital + procedure: the most recent priceVintage wins, then more accepted MRF lines, then the lexically smallest mrfUrl; losers are quarantined as row:duplicate_superseded

note: Prices exactly as published by hospitals in their own files. Nothing is estimated.
